report_artifact_source_valid.name: report_artifact_source_valid
report_artifact_source_valid.value: ("chatwork_report_artifacts"."kind" IN ('body','markdown','pdf') AND "chatwork_report_artifacts"."source_id" IS NULL) OR ("chatwork_report_artifacts"."kind"='image' AND "chatwork_report_artifacts"."source_id" IS NOT NULL)

report_snapshot_request_status.name: report_snapshot_request_status
report_snapshot_request_status.value: ("report_snapshot_requests"."status" = 'Linked' AND "report_snapshot_requests"."candidate_id" IS NOT NULL AND "report_snapshot_requests"."fingerprint" IS NOT NULL) OR ("report_snapshot_requests"."status" = 'Fenced' AND "report_snapshot_requests"."candidate_id" IS NULL AND "report_snapshot_requests"."fingerprint" IS NULL)
